values./system/biography: A modified Mister Handy serving Nuka-Cola with a dangerously radioactive sprayer.
values./items/@ef20fac86b2fb748/system/descript: END + Big Guns (TN 11), Burst, Range C, Fire Rate 3.
values./items/@45e3ba880b9a9dc2/system/descript: This character is a robot: it cannot use consumables or heal naturally, and damage must be repaired. It is immune to hunger, thirst and suffocation.
values./items/@ae18ea78e7291a02/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@0efd3c9d47c6d198/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@4364866c4f30e549/system/descript: Mr. Frothy has 360-degree vision and ignores difficult ground terrain.
values./items/@01daee4c90787a27/system/descript: At 4 HP or fewer it self-destructs for 6 DC Energy damage with Radioactive and Blast.
values./items/@5281df06e7a70f00/system/descript: Once per combat add Fire Rate to Nuka-Sprayer damage (6 DC total) and add Burst without ammunition.
